summary: All z-harness plan artifacts resolve under an external artifact base via scripts/plan-path.sh: a 5-tier fallback chain (Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR > $XDG_STATE_HOME > $HOME/.local/state > <git-common-dir>/z-harness > ./z-harness) that is EXTERNAL BY DEFAULT (Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT unset == 1), so a parallel `git clean` can no longer wipe gitignored plans. A <git-common-dir>/.z-harness-base anchor pins the chosen base (split-brain guard); tier-1 explicit Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR bypasses the anchor (CI/benchmark escape hatch). Within the base: plans at <base>/plans/<slug>/, registry at <base>/active-plans/, followups at <base>/followups/, metrics at <base>/metrics.jsonl. scripts/migrate-plan-layout.sh is a full-scope NON-DESTRUCTIVE migrator (copy->verify->rm) for moving existing in-repo artifacts out.
key_invariants: Path construction MUST go through scripts/plan-path.sh helpers (base_dir/plan_dir/active_plans_dir/followups_dir/all_plan_slugs/resolve_plan_path) — inline z-harness/ literals are a DRY violation.

z_harness_base() writes/validates the <git-common-dir>/.z-harness-base anchor on tiers 2-5; anchor mismatch is a hard FATAL (split-brain protection). Tier-1 explicit Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR neither reads nor writes the anchor (escape hatch); must be absolute.
External base is the DEFAULT (Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT unset == 1); =0 (or Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR=$(pwd)/z-harness) reverts to in-repo, which requires deleting a stale external anchor first.
Helpers that compose on z_harness_base() propagate its failure and refuse to build paths on an empty base (never glob or write under /).

migrate-plan-layout.sh safe_move is always copy -> verify(byte-equal AND source mtime unchanged) -> rm; the source is removed only after verify passes; refuse-on-conflict (never overwrite a non-empty target, except metrics.jsonl which is dedup-merged).
migrate-plan-layout.sh REFUSES a real move while any active-plan registry record is status:running (live-run barrier, invariant 8); --dry-run warns but still previews.
metrics.jsonl migration is dedup-append (idempotent across crash/re-run); followups/ migration is opt-in (--with-followups) to avoid stranding in-flight locks.

key_files.why: Single source of truth for path resolution: z_harness_repo_id, z_harness_base/base_dir (5-tier chain + anchor), active_plans_dir, followups_dir, plan_dir, resolve_plan_path (dual-read), all_plan_slugs (both layouts).
Full-scope non-destructive migrator: --dry-run/--all/--with-followups/--slug; live-run barrier; safe_move copy/verify/rm; merge_metrics; canonicalize_path self-migration guard; empty-dir cleanup.
Routes events + metrics.jsonl through z_harness_base(); source-loop-guarded (_Z_HARNESS_RESOLVING_BASE) so emitting base_resolved doesn't recurse.
User-facing guide: fallback chain, anchor, external-default flip + opt-out, migration commands, command-coverage checklist.
